programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Penguins face the Flyers in Game 3 of the East first round at Xfinity Mobile Arena. The Flyers lead the series 2-0. After a scoreless first, the Flyers struck twice in the second. Porter Martone opened the scoring for the second consecutive game.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Flyers take on the Penguins in Game 4 of the East First Round at Xfinity Mobile Arena. Leading 3-0 after two road wins, the Flyers scored three second-period goals on four shots. Trevor Zegras and Noah Cates each had a goal in the home victory.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: Philadelphia Flyers face Pittsburgh Penguins in Game 5 of the Eastern Conference first round at PPG Paints Arena. Philadelphia holds a 3-1 advantage in the best-of-seven series following Pittsburgh's 4-2 victory to stay alive in Game 4.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
